name: Aubergine couscous salad
assumptions: Yield estimated at 2 main-course servings based on total dry couscous (140g) and vegetable quantities typical for 2 portions in similar salad recipes.
Preparation time summed from explicit instruction times (15 min grilling + 10 min couscous soaking) plus ~5 min for prep/mixing, rounded conservatively.
Goat's cheese classified as dairy (Milk allergen true) and incompatible with Vegan/Dairy-free.
Couscous from durum wheat classified as containing Wheat (Gluten-free false).
No explicit barley/rye; Vegetarian confirmed by source and ingredients; Pescatarian compatible as no meat/fish.
instructions:
step 1
Heat grill to high. Put the aubergine on a baking sheet, brush with oil and season. Grill for about 15 mins, turning and brushing with more oil halfway, until browned and softened.

step 2
Meanwhile, tip the couscous into a large bowl, pour over the stock, then cover and leave for 10 mins. Mix the tomatoes, mint, goat’s cheese and remaining oil together. Fluff the couscous up with a fork, then stir in the aubergines, tomato mixture and lemon juice.

ingredients.name: Aubergine
ingredients.assumptions: Medium aubergine (300g whole) sliced; edible portion after trimming ends, typical for grilling in salad recipes.

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 3 tablespoons olive oil (standard 13-14g per tbsp); fully used for brushing and in the final mix per instructions.

ingredients.name: Couscous
ingredients.assumptions: Dry couscous as specified; standard nutritional profile for uncooked durum wheat couscous before absorbing stock.

ingredients.name: Vegetable Stock
ingredients.assumptions: Prepared vegetable stock/broth; low-calorie liquid fully absorbed by couscous, typical commercial or homemade values.

ingredients.name: Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients.assumptions: Whole cherry tomatoes as listed; standard fresh values, halved or mixed per instructions but weighed raw.

ingredients.name: Mint
ingredients.assumptions: 'Handful' of fresh mint leaves estimated at 15g (common recipe volume for a generous handful in salads); typical fresh herb nutrition.

ingredients.name: Goats Cheese
ingredients.assumptions: Soft goat's cheese as listed; standard values for fresh/chevre style commonly crumbled into salads.

ingredients.name: Lemon
ingredients.assumptions: Juice of 1/2 lemon estimated at 15g (standard yield per half); typical fresh lemon juice values, stirred in at end.
